visualCalibration.frontCredit: Adolf Mas Ginestà, Fons Col·leccions, as presented by COAC
visualCalibration.method: Facade storey elevations and relief dimensions estimated from the front photograph and custodian details, calibrated by measured plan width and source ground/roof tiers. Photographs do not supply complete XYZ facade profiles; ornament and intermediate depths remain synthetic.

dragon.profileMethod: The ridge is constrained by samples near b22. The forward fall retains the separately sampled curved front profile (centre57.721m at b24–24.5) rather than dropping to the uniform main terrace elevation. The high ridge remains behind the visible front crest. The eastern roof eave is set back: samples at a5.5 fall from53.314m at b23 to48.921m at b24.5; its low profile therefore stays near main roof rather than rising to match the central crest. Interpolation between transects is an approximation.

parameters.replacement: icgc-1200192 contains the entire connected block and is deliberately omitted from explicit replacement IDs. The facade envelope must be checked against the retained general block before publication.
parameters.chimneyApproximation: Four groups registered to sampled elevated returns; four representative shafts per group. Flared shared feet, sinuous stems, broad collars, conical caps and top balls follow the custodian rooftop photograph. The number of individual stacks and their fine sections are simplified rather than transcribed exactly.
